FN-F2PI55C-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 48
Committee: State Governmental Affairs Sponsor: Senator Bobby D. Singleton
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 02/10/2025
Senate Bill 48 as introduced could increase the obligations of the State General Fund by an
estimated maximum of $3.2 million to increase the state-paid salary of all registrars in the state
from $80 per day, currently, to $150 per day.
Page 1

Senate Bill 48 as reported by the Committee on State Governmental Affairs could increase the
obligations of the State General Fund by an estimated maximum of $1.6 million to increase the
state-paid salary of all registrars in the state from $80 per day, currently, to $115 per day.

FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 48
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Senator Bobby D. Singleton
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 02/14/2025
Senate Bill 48 as passed the Senate could increase the annual obligations of the State General
Fund by an estimated maximum of $1.6 million to increase the state-paid salary of all registrars
in the state from $80 per day, currently, to $115 per day.
